name: Override: both red Toggles and a stack
description: Starts facing red's wall with the Toggle bars over the left Toggle, not touching it. Hits the left Toggle twice (blue, then red), drives through the yellow stack at (23.5, -23.5) and closes the claw on it on the way, sets it on the neutral bottom Goal, then hits the bottom Toggle twice. Red has 50 points at 12.9 s and takes the Autonomous Bonus.

steps.note: back the bars off the left Toggle
back onto the line through the yellow stack and the neutral bottom Goal
through the yellow stack at (23.5, -23.5) onto the neutral bottom Goal
let go and back out of the bite
line up on the bottom Toggle
hit 1: blue, at 8 V so the Toggle does not spin past red
